tasks.subject: Phase 1: Foundation and shared contracts (tasks 1.1–1.4)
tasks.description: Adopt domain language repo-wide (1.1), replace docs/PROTOCOL.md with role-separated contracts (1.2), define privacy allowlists + schema/contract tests before networking (1.3), split semantic core into own module and establish repo boundaries (1.4). Per openspec/changes/multi-harness-rebuild.

tasks.subject: Phase 2: Edge Bridge + Codex adapter (tasks 2.1–2.7)
tasks.description: Task Presence ID assignment + private mapping (2.1), absolute-report storage (2.2), generation/seq rejection + leases + retention + ack/snooze (2.3), Codex lifecycle reduction in adapters/codex (2.4), capability router + fail-closed Codex focus (2.5), dual-mode owner-only IPC (2.6), App Server enrichment Codex-private (2.7).
tasks.activeForm: Implementing Edge Bridge and Codex adapter

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Pi adapter + same-machine acceptance (tasks 3.1–3.3)
tasks.description: Leased adapters/pi status-only mapping (3.1), concurrent Codex+Pi through one Edge (3.2), prove test matrix: UUID isolation, stale rejection, reconnect repair, lease cleanup, independent failure, privacy boundary (3.3).

tasks.subject: Phase 4: Pairing, feeds, BOX-3 firmware (tasks 4.1–4.6)
tasks.description: Device-code pairing ceremony with revocable role-scoped credentials (4.1), complete-replacement feed snapshots (4.2), four concurrent WSS feeds in firmware (4.3), scrollable list + Featured Task + FIFO + pet-tap Focus (4.4), acknowledge/snooze gestures (4.5), physical hardware validation — USER REQUIRED (4.6).

tasks.subject: Phase 5: Home relay (Workers + DO) + administration (tasks 5.1–5.8)
tasks.description: Home Worker scaffold with DO per Home (5.1), one-Home persistence + single-admin auth + CSRF (5.2), Edge ingress WSS + hibernation (5.3), reverse action routing (5.4), Home-to-device feeds + dashboard data (5.5), browser admin client as static assets (5.6), headless Edge CLI (5.7), Native SDK Edge admin client (5.8). Deploy only with explicit authorization.

tasks.subject: Phase 6–7: Local acceptance, hardening, deferred guard (tasks 6.1–7.2)
tasks.description: Local Edge→Home acceptance with duplicate convergence (6.1), failure-mode exercises (6.2), threat model (6.3), privacy invariant end-to-end (6.4), release/hardware docs (6.5), deferred-scope confirmations (7.1, 7.2).
